knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Planning a relief worker for a job that depends on one person prevents unfinished work when someone is absent.
The last-out check confirms that doors are locked and client items are accounted for before the crew leaves.
The sample requires the business to keep the client informed when a risk such as power loss affects the work.
The property security and labelling section says the control is a supervisor check after the work is finished, so workers take responsibility for locking rooms.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes a site risk table for a supplied site, with a control, a checker and a review date for each risk.
The learner completes a last-out check on a simulated site and records the locked rooms and returned items.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer to the supervisor any job that cannot be completed safely with the staff available.
Stop and inform the supervisor if a client's property cannot be accounted for.
